name: EIA Short-Term Energy Outlook — August 2026
known_limitations: The August 2026 outlook is a forecast completed August 6, not observed future demand or proof that proposed data-center loads will connect. Its Texas revision reflects stated modeling assumptions and can be revised in later editions.
automation_notes: Bind every use to the August 2026 forecast vintage and preserve later-revision risk.
factual_nucleus: EIA released the outlook on August 11 after completing the forecast on August 6. It lowered forecast Texas electricity-load growth for 2027 to 6%, from 14% in the prior outlook, after the Texas governor announced an August 3 pause on new data-center development.
notes: Phase 177 current official-source addition checked 2026-09-01. Forecast content is context, not an operating-outcome decision.
